claim: Fresh derived-timing seed 990021 stopped before the bedroom because the fixed intro script assumed every front-end input was consumed. The failure preceded objective execution, battles, and every learned control role. It is a preserved bootstrap robustness defect, not a model-prediction failure.

failure.message: The clean run missed the input-ready bedroom gate.

direct_reproduction.blind_confirm_trial: Sixteen A pulses did not start the game.
direct_reproduction.bounded_frontend_trial: Repeating Start,A,A,A under 240-frame waits reached the bedroom on the eighteenth input; one readiness wait settled the exact gate.

diagnosis.finding: The initial 0–255-frame perturbation can change which title/menu inputs are accepted. The old intro issued a fixed sequence and sampled the bedroom once; this seed remained outside the running game.
diagnosis.model_boundary: No mechanic objective, learned battle, switch-target, training-control, or trainee/venue decision had occurred. The scheduled battle controller consumed zero of 74 entries.

repair.behavior: After the original intro sequence, a bounded 32-input recovery cycles Start,A,A,A with 240-frame waits until the exact clean bedroom and input-ready semantic gate is observed. Once the bedroom exists but controls are still settling, it waits without sending input. Any other started map fails immediately.
repair.public_receipt: The opening report publishes the number of actual bedroom-recovery input pulses, excluding input-free settling waits, and requires it to be nonnegative.
repair.historical_integrity: July source-bound receipts use a pinned historical opening-timing dictionary; current robustness fields do not rewrite old evidence.
repair.rom_free_gate: Public-artifact and documentation checks, regenerated-registry check, Ruff, mypy across 128 source modules, and 2,180 tests passed; three integration tests were deselected and one expected failure remained expected.
repair.next_gate: Commit and push the qualified repair, then run a fresh uncounted derived-timing root. Counted v95 remains unopened.
